source_text:
㊟: So it should go into futon1b, that's fine.  I know sometimes this makes post-processing (e.g. catch up by 象) ambiguous and my "long turns" look different, but that's a problem to solve in the evidence-processing phase not in the evidence-storage phase (and 象 may remember its rule about triple-greater-than even in the catch-up phase).

㊭ I think we sohuld get back to the idea of thinking about 小象 as a "prior" for 象, and use the corrections of the provisional reading from 象 as a way to train 小象.  We could include a little bit of material about this training process in the writeup at https://hyperreal.enterprises/xiaoxiang.html

㊯ I'd also like you to give me a short draft paragraph that I can send to Brendan Fong that explains how we are working on using his work.  I'm hoping I might be able to arrange a meeting with him to discuss later this week.  (I know we are in a preliminary phase of this work; but maybe it could lead to a joint publication or something later on.)
